palette.notes: Saturated Genesis-style palette: Mirage Saloon uses sand yellows and oranges, maroon/red patterned walls and a cool sky gradient; blue Sonic pops against the warm ground. Clip 1 is a reaction video, ignored.

lighting: Flat sprite lighting from above-left; depth comes from banded colour (sky gradient, mesa layers) rather than cast light.
silhouette: Sonic is a compact blue ball with spikes; in rolls and spins he becomes a pure blue circle, readable at very small size against busy patterns.

motion.timing: Not measured (no metrics file). Frames show fast run/roll cycles and ball-form jumps; level art moves by parallax while the hero stays near centre.

texture: Clean Genesis-era sprite work with hard patterned tiles (Navajo-style diamonds on walls), dithered sky bands and small foreground props (cacti, barrels).
camera: Side-scrolling camera following the hero with layered parallax mesas; title card ('Mirage Saloon Zone 2') with diagonal colour bands as a zone intro.

acting.enters: Zone title card slides in on diagonal colour stripes, then the hero is already running.
acting.acts: Constant movement: runs, curls into a ball, bounces off springs, rides props; idle never lasts.
acting.exits: Exits by speed off the edge or into a loop or tube; story cutscenes between levels (by Tyson Hesse) carry the character acting.
acting.depth: Mostly one gameplay plane; parallax background layers sell depth behind the hero.

techniques: shape-change pose: character becomes a simple ball for fast motion
warm patterned ground + cool sky so the blue hero reads
parallax background layers at different speeds
diagonal stripe title card as section intro
small foreground props passing in front for depth
feel: warm saturated tiles + cool blue hero + always-moving ball pose = pure energy
for_fred: Give Fred a 'speed form': for fast travel collapse him into a simple shape (a tight orange arc or blur) instead of animating every swim frame, then pop back to full pose on arrival. Use a diagonal stripe card to open a new section of the reel.
